## Round

First review of PR #2566 (R10-HANDOVER-REFRESH, branch fix/r10-handover-refresh), measured at head `c7f727478e3d4ec7dbe7a1284cd7634ce0aa7651`. Merge base `5006687576713535518634a154f7de1824432219`; origin/main at review `1ebc737e7e187a1d45c62069ae8ab69c465db928`. The contract is current: `git diff <merge-base>...origin/main -- dev/governance/roles/` is empty. Reviewer seat: cloud, finder-side instruments only. The self-test is the one `governance.yml:543` runs, and the mutants are this seat's own.

## Findings

- Observation: two of this seat's own mutants on `tools/audit/seat/handover_prompt.py` `pickup()` survive the self-test (`15 checks, 0 failed`). M4 drops the `if note:` true-branch clause `; read the note file and check its commit equals the fetched head`. M6 changes `FETCH_HEAD` to `HEAD` in the worktree command. M4's conditional is new in this diff, and only its false side is pinned (M3 kills `if True:`). M6's text was unpinned at the merge base too (`in-flight pickup command` asserts only the fetch ref and the note path). Neither is reachable as a wrong output on the live roster: `wave-r10-groups.json` at `b6e8c76e` has 0 of 128 resume entries carrying `note_file`, so the note-true branch never renders in round 10. Carry: dismissed: unreachable on the round-10 roster, and the unpinned clause predates this diff (item 93527d8c)

## Evidence

- Mutation proof (`ev/mutants.txt`), `python3 -I tools/audit/seat/handover_prompt.py --self-test`, each mutant restored, and `git diff --stat` empty afterwards. RESULT head 15 checks, 0 failed. RESULT M1 `if not branch:`→`if False:` 1 failed. RESULT M2 unconditional note clause 1 failed. RESULT M3 `if note:`→`if True:` 1 failed. RESULT M5 no-branch line → `` `git fetch origin None` `` 1 failed. RESULT M0 drop the pickup line 3 failed, which matches the body's M0. M4 and M6 survive (F1). The base self-test gives `13 checks, 0 failed`, as the body says.
- Generator null control (`ev/gen_counts.txt`, `ev/gen61_*.txt`), base worktree `500668757` vs head, roster `61eaa993` (the body's). RESULT base 23 in-flight, `None` 23, `git fetch origin None` 4. RESULT head 23 in-flight, `None` 0, `git fetch origin None` 0, `no branch pushed yet` 4. 23 changed lines. This matches the body exactly. On the current roster `b6e8c76e`, the in-flight count is 16 at both ends, base `None` is 16 and fetchNone 4, and head `None` is 0 and nobranch 4.
- Layout-guard null control (`ev/null_layout_c2902.txt`). RESULT `c2902d6c` against `0cc148b2f`: rc=1, `new-reference: dev/programme/HANDOVER.md cites retired path docs/HANDOVER.md`, `GUARD: 1 refusal(s)`. RESULT head against the merge base `500668757`: rc=0, `GUARD: 0 refusal(s)`. Against `03b49e152`: `0 refusal(s)`.
- Trap 51 is true at this head against the instruments it names. `tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh:25` runs only `tools/pr/ci_predict.py --base origin/main`. `grep -n -i layout tools/pr/ci_predict.py` hits only the `closure.layout_errors` docstring at line 337, so the predictor has no layout-guard arm. `tools/pr/prepr.sh` `moved_line()` (line 763) runs `python3 -I tests/layout.py --guard --base <merge base>`, the command the trap prescribes. Its rc=0 / `0 refusal(s)` pass reading matches the guard's output above. Nothing outside the file cites trap 51 except this PR's own delivery row title (`ev/traps.txt`).
- The other new traps were spot-checked at head (`ev/traps.txt`). Trap 47: `merge_pr.sh` lets UNSTABLE past its red-check read ("OPTIONAL-RED, proceeding"), then exits `not clean` unless the state is CLEAN or HAS_HOOKS, so it stops on UNSTABLE, as stated. Trap 52: `/usr/local/bin/python3` is 3.11.17, and `tests/entities.py` dies with `SyntaxError: f-string: expecting '}'` before any check, as stated. Trap 11 is still at number 11 and still what `.claude/hooks/session-start.sh:10` cites. The deleted `CORPUS_EXCLUDED` sentence is gone from the handover, and `policy_lint.mjs` keeps `'docs/HANDOVER.md'` (lines 470, 6191), consistent with the body's canon() account.
- `updated-for:` names `0cc148b2f80fe224ffe2c504b29fd4f0908183df`, an ancestor of both the head and origin/main.
- Group control (roster spec at `origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster` `b6e8c76e`): "the policy budgets for the file do not grow". `node tools/policy/policy_lint.mjs --budgets` output is byte-identical at the base worktree and at head (`ev/budgets_base.txt`, `ev/budgets_head.txt`, `diff` empty), and both have rc=0. The roster's `carry[0]` (`git fetch origin None`) is what `pickup()` discharges. It takes the spec's "emit no fetch line" option and does not guess the branch-to-be.
- Scope (`ev/figures.txt`): `tests/closure.py select --diff <merge base>` gives `MODE: SCOPED -- 1 script(s) run, 32 scoped out`, and `run` = `tests/entities.py`, as in the body.
- RESULT `env -u BASH_ENV PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 tests/entities.py` at head: rc=0, `ALL 2382 ENTITY CHECKS PASSED`. This seat did not re-derive the body's 2375. The body's figures predate the `500668757` merge and the row commit, and 2382 is the count at this head. `tests/structure.py`: `STRUCTURE RATCHET PASSED`. `policy_lint.mjs`: `TOTAL: 0 error(s) across 41 policy file(s)`, rc=0. `rules_sync.mjs --check`: rc=0.
- `VERSION`, the manifest and `RELEASE_NOTES.md` are untouched by the three-dot diff. No `*_budgets.json` is touched. No claim file is touched, so `env_drift.py --all` has nothing to compare.
- Merge (`ev/merge.txt`): `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main(1ebc737e) c7f72747` gives tree `32e2eea9`, rc=0, clean.
- CI on this head (`ev/checkruns.tsv`, commit check-runs API): all 49 check-runs had concluded by 21:28Z: 32 success, 16 skipped, 1 failure. The Tests run 39674131246 jobs (`closures`, `coverage-ratchet`, `graders-head-copy`, `lane-proofs`) were queued at first read, and each concluded success. `Analyze (python)` concluded success. The heavy runs are cited, not re-run.
- The only red is `nightly-status` (check-run 119479409582, `ev/nightly_status_head.txt`): `NIGHTLY FAILED: mutation-nightly, slow failed last night`, scheduled run 39563978649 on main at `c77f89d`. That is the same run and the same two jobs the body's `## Red checks` names and answers under the check's name, with a cheaper-detector analysis. Its own log says it is not a required context on `main-protect` and does not block a merge. It grades main's nightly, not this diff. `pr-contract` ran twice at this head, both success, and the second started at 20:53:34Z, after nightly-status concluded red at 20:53:15Z.
- The body's head chain names `c7f72747` as origin/main `500668757` merged plus the delivery-row commit, and the three-dot diff confirms it (HANDOVER.md, `dev/programme/delivery/2566.md`, `handover_prompt.py`).
- Two figures this seat did not re-derive. The live ruleset and issue reads were not re-read: they would only re-confirm the retirements the body records, and trap text does not depend on them. The `tests.yml` #1122 grep was also left alone. The body's "R10-REPLAY-CAP (in-progress)" was true at its read; the current roster has it `done`. Neither is a defect of the diff.
